mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic growth, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Unemployment rises above 9% but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate and high unemployment indicate a sluggish economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Both FEDFUNDS are low and UNRATE is high but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate in a tightening cycle leads to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Industrial production growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing employment suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Employment increases but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation indicated by CPI suggests tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPI exceeds 240 but S&P 500 returns are positive.
